text:
ryan-ci: deploybot held the canary promo 10m ago — image pull errors on eu-west replicas and a couple flaky e2e timeouts. holding promotion until we decide.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary promotion paused for release v3.14.2. Reason: 3 failures (image_layer_mismatch, e2e_timeout). See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/3519876543
maria-dev: looking at the image pull log, getting: "digest mismatch: wanted sha256:abcd... got sha256:ef01..." on two nodes. seems like a pushed image digest changed during upload or registry returned stale blob. :grimacing:
simon-eng: could be a cross-region propagation issue. If the registry had a stale manifest, some nodes pulled old layer refs. Has anyone tried pulling the exact digest locally? test pull might reproduce.
alex-sre: reproducer on my laptop: `docker pull gcr.io/rw-inference/service:v3.14.2@sha256:ef01...` -> fails with `blob mount unknown`. Registry returned 404 for layer blob.
maria-dev: ok, that matches. I also see the CI artifact upload step succeeded earlier but the registry reported a 202 then later 200. maybe a race in the registry's async copy between regions.
jenna-release: we have a 2-hour change window starting in 45m. Options: 1) rollback canary to v3.14.1 now, unblock promotion; 2) pin promotion to previous good digest and re-run canary; 3) wait and retry push/replicate then re-run tests. Thoughts?
simon-eng: +1 for pinning digest and re-run canary. Rolling back whole canary might be heavy; pin is lowest blast radius. But need a reliable way to force the old digest.
ryan-ci: how confident are we we have the previous good digest? CI artifacts show v3.14.1 digest: sha256:a1b2c3d4. We can update the canary imageRef to `image@sha256:a1b2c3d4` and redeploy.
maria-dev: I can prepare a quick k8s patch. `kubectl set image deploy/service-canary service=gcr.io/rw-inference/service@sha256:a1b2c3d4 --record`
alex-sre: before that, I'd like to confirm the unhealthy pods count and e2e failure traces. The e2e timeouts look unrelated (timed out waiting for readiness) but likely downstream of image pulls. Logs:
```
Pulling image "gcr.io/rw-inference/service:v3.14.2"...
failed to extract layer: blob not found: sha256:deadbeef
pod never reached Ready
```
jenna-release: ops ask for a cut: if we pin, we should also create an incident note and schedule a follow-up to re-push v3.14.2 once registry is healthy. Can we do the pin + re-run within the change window?
simon-eng: yes. Maria, can you patch and trigger a manual canary redeploy? I'll watch the rollout and run the smoke suite.
maria-dev: on it. applying patch now.
deploy-bot: [automated] Received imageRef patch for deployment service-canary by maria-dev. Starting rollout.
ryan-ci: smoke started. running subset of critical path tests only to be quick.
alex-sre: monitor shows pods on eu-west spinning up with sha256:a1b2c3d4. no pull errors so far. :thumbsup:
jenna-release: nice. if smoke passes, do we want to advance canary and then hold final promotion until morning? I'd prefer to avoid promoting v3.14.2 tonight until registry propagation root cause is fixed.
simon-eng: agree. we'll unhold canary (so prod sees the pinned digest) but keep final promote blocked. Create a follow-up ticket to investigate registry async copy and add a pre-publish manifest verification step.
maria-dev: smoke green. smoke logs: readiness OK, latency within baseline. e2e short run passed 5/5.
deploy-bot: [automated] Canary rollout successful (service-canary -> sha256:a1b2c3d4). Promotion still paused by manual hold.
ryan-ci: decision: pin canary to previous digest (sha256:a1b2c3d4), unblock traffic routing for canary, keep promotion to stable blocked until registry investigation completes. Opening ticket now: INC-2026-143.
jenna-release: noted. I'll update the release notes and change log: add a rollback/pin entry and a note that v3.14.2 promotion deferred due to registry layer propagation. Sending a short customer-facing blurb to comms.
simon-eng: I'll take the registry follow-up: add manifest checksum verification during publish and a short script to wait for cross-region replication. Filing RFC PR.
alex-sre: adding monitoring alert to catch blob mount 404 spikes across regions.
maria-dev: leaving a quick runbook in the ticket: how to pin, how to revert, and how to re-push with `gcloud artifacts docker tags` sanity. saves next on-call time.
ryan-ci: thanks all. summary for the thread: pin canary to previous digest, canary healthy, promo blocked, follow-ups: INC-2026-143 (registry), RFC-246 (publish verification), update release notes. We'll reconvene tomorrow 09:30 UTC if no registry regressions. :white_check_mark:
